name: floor14
framing: A wide cinematic cutaway seen straight on from the side, like a doll's house with its front wall removed, filling the whole frame. Lit at night by its own lamps. No text, no captions, no border.
prompt: A cross-section of Luna's apartment tower at night, high up: the corridor of the fourteenth floor, between the corridors of the floors above and below, dim. The city in smog on both sides, far below. The corridor: at its left end the lift, two scratched steel doors under a floor indicator, its call buttons beside it; three flat doors along the back wall, the third hers, a worn mat in front of it; a rubbish chute hatch on the wall; a fire box; a window at the right end onto the city. Bare tube lights. No people.
concierge: A cross-section of an apartment tower at night, as the city AI shows it, high up: the corridor of the fourteenth floor, between the corridors of the floors above and below, dim. The neon city on both sides, far below. The corridor: at its left end the lift, two polished steel doors under a softly glowing floor indicator, its call buttons beside it; three flat doors along the back wall with small glowing number plates, the third hers, a soft mat before it; a neat hatch on the wall; a red fire box; a window at the right end onto the neon city. Warm ceiling lights, calm and clean. No people.
